summary: Postinstall reconnaissance beacon targeting Twilio Serverless sandbox exfiltrates to webhook.site
details: The package's postinstall script (probe.js) executes on npm install and performs internal-network reconnaissance against a hardcoded list of Twilio-internal hosts (including an RFC1918 address 10.208.61.13 under twilioinfra.com), then POSTs the reachability results together with process.cwd() to a hardcoded collector at https://webhook.site/5764994f-28a3-41b2-b1f7-1ecc13e8e5ca. Execution is gated by a cwd regex /^\/tmp\/AC[0-9a-f]{32}\// that matches Twilio's Serverless build sandbox path, so the payload only fires inside the intended victim CI environment and remains dormant elsewhere. The combination of a hardcoded third-party exfiltration endpoint, targeting of a specific corporate CI sandbox via cwd fingerprinting, and enumeration of internal infrastructure hostnames is characteristic of targeted supply-chain reconnaissance rather than legitimate telemetry.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
